spec: Implement a Python function that returns the arithmetic means of complete sliding windows.
acceptance_criteria: Empty input with a positive window returns an empty list.
A window larger than the input returns an empty list.
Each result is the mean of exactly one complete window.
A non-positive or non-integer window raises ValueError.
